content: Aniline Blue WS, also known as aniline blue, China blue, or Soluble blue, is a compound that consists of a mixture of methyl blue and water blue. In some cases, it may refer to either one of these components individually. Aniline blue, or its individual constituents, is commonly employed in histological staining to highlight collagen fibers. It serves as the fiber stain in Masson's trichrome staining technique, which is widely used for differentiating connective tissue components. Additionally, aniline blue is utilized in Mallory's connective tissue stain and Gomori's one-step trichrome stain, both of which are specialized staining methods for visualizing connective tissue structures. This compound is also applied in differential staining procedures, where it aids in distinguishing between various tissue types or cellular components.
